metadata.case_name: LEUNG HING SUM v. YAU LEE CONSTRUCTION CO. LTD. AND OTHERS

injuries.description: 36% second degree burns to his face, lips, neck, anterior trunk and both of his upper limbs.
injuries.body_part: face, lips, neck, anterior trunk, both upper limbs
source: The plaintiff suffered 36% second degree burns to his face, lips, neck, anterior trunk and both of his upper limbs.

injuries.description: Thermal induced pupitis affecting upper anterior teeth with hypersensitivity and enamel pitting.
source: In addition to his physical burns, the plaintiff was found to have suffered thermal induced pupitis as a result of the electric shock he received.

A few of his upper anterior teeth were still hypersenitive to cold air and hot water 5 months after the accident. The labial surfaces of those upper anterior teeth showed enamel pitting which resembled the look of melted enamel.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of hard dental tissues and pulp

injuries.description: Post-traumatic adjustment disorder / post-traumatic depression with impairment in psychological, social and occupational functioning.
source: Dr. Chan Chung Mau diagnosed the plaintiff to be suffering from post-traumatic depression with impairment in his psychological, social and occupational functioning.

manifestations.description: Patches of scars on his body over his face, neck, chest and extensively over his left and right upper limbs; scars over face and neck less noticeable after 4 years while scars on arms and hands hypopigmented or hypertrophic; hypopigmented scars at donor sites of thighs.
Scar contracture causing pulling discomfort over left elbow, two wrists and web space of right hand.
Reduced strength of upper limbs and reduced hand grip.
Pain, irritation and itchiness around scars in region of elbow and wrists (ongoing at assessment).
Hypersensitivity of a few upper anterior teeth to cold air and hot water for 5 months after the accident; enamel pitting of labial surfaces.
Withdrawn behaviour; no desire to participate in social and sporting activities; felt inferior and unworthy; occasional suicidal thoughts.
Depression and anxiety; insomnia and difficulty falling asleep; insomnia aggravated by itchiness of scars at night.
Reduced sexual urge and reduced sexual activity from once a week to less than once a month.
Impairment in psychological, social and occupational functioning (assessed by Dr. Chan at 15%-20% in December 1999).

treatments_received: wore pressure jacket for some 2 years
scaling, polishing, composite resin fillings (dental treatment)
treatments_future: 26 sessions of psychiatric counselling at HK$1,200 per session (accepted as reasonable)

losses.description: Physical and cosmetic disabilities from burns and scarring to face, neck, chest and upper limbs.
Reduced strength of upper limbs and reduced hand grip due to scar contracture.
Not fit to attend to daily activities during recuperation; required domestic helper to apply medication and put on pressure jacket.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: No further desire to participate in sporting activities such as basketball, badminton and swimming.
Became withdrawn and had no desire to participate in social activities.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Sexual urge dropped and sexual activities reduced from once a week to less than once a month.
Post-traumatic depression with feelings of inferiority, withdrawal, and occasional suicidal thoughts.
